text:
emma: FYI bringing up reranker v4 (fp16 -> PTQ int8) hit a ~-0.033 NDCG@10 and -0.014 MRR@10 on smoke-20k-mixed. No weight changes; ingest changed doc boundary token and priming pad.

rick: What exactly changed?

emma: We moved from two newlines to a literal `<DOC-BRK>` in ingestion, and templates now prepend a PRIME64 pad token region. Eval: `./eval/run.py --model rerank-v4-int8 --holdout smoke-20k-mixed --k 10 --seed 11`. Logs: https://artifacts/479001 (summary csv).

zara: Quick experiments to isolate: (A) baseline as-is, (B) replace `<DOC-BRK>` -> "\n\n" at eval time, (C) strip PRIME64 before tokenization, (D) both. Also dump tokenizer seqlen histogram.

eval-bot: Job started 77421 (variants A-D). Artifacts: https://console.redwood/jobs/77421. ETA ~20m.

emma: Results: B +0.029 NDCG@10, C +0.007, D +0.036 (negligible delta vs fp16). MRR similar. Seqlen mean +5.9% with new ingest; 95th +10.8%.

rick: Strong sign formatting/distribution shift caused the apparent quant regression. Actions: add a formatting-parity preproc to bringup checklist, add seqlen-drift guard (>5% mean or 95th) to quant pipeline, and require a normalized-pipeline FP16 vs INT8 smoke diff with NDCG@10 delta <= 0.01 before promoting.

zara: Filed INF-4721: "reranker-v4 bringup - enforce ingest parity + seqlen guardrails" with repro snippet and exact eval flags. Pushed tiny normalizer to bringup branch. Per-query deltas uploaded to job artifacts.

emma: Will re-run full PTQ flow once preproc parity patch lands and post final sign-off here. Ping for raw CSV if you want slice breakdowns.
